documentation.content: A managed pipeline-worker execution returned a non-success result. Inspect the Cloud Run execution logs, then use `paloma-data pipeline-status` and the production runbook before retrying work.

conditions.displayName: Cloud Run worker execution result is not succeeded

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="paloma-pipeline-worker" AND resource.labels.location="us-west1" AND metric.labels.result!="succeeded"
